facts.fact: Ecofin reports Mauritania's Ministry of Digital Transformation opened digital service centers with free internet access, in Nouakchott outskirts from July 2025, Ouadane in December 2025 and Bassikounou on 23 February 2026, as a first phase to expand to all municipalities.

MRT.note: The centers give help with online services; no programme teaching digital skills to the public is stated.
The centers help people reach online services; no count of services or portal is stated.

facts.fact: Ecofin, citing the ITU ICT Development Index 2025, puts internet penetration in Mauritania at 37.4%.

MRT.note: The centers are public-access sites for residents, not local government office connections.

facts.fact: Ecofin, citing ITU estimates, says 79.1% of Mauritania's population owns a mobile phone.
